deploy-bot: Starting rollout: EU canary v2.1.7 -> 5% traffic in eu-west-1 (initiated at 12:07 UTC)
carla (oncall): noticing spike in 503s for /v1/generate — can someone grab traces?
maria (eng): pulling logs, seeing 503/504s from inference-gateway -> upstream edge-backend timeouts
devin (sre): incident-bot paged carla — high error rate on canary endpoint
incident-bot: page: carla (oncall) — high error rate detected for /v1/generate (eu canary). severity: P1. See attached perf graph.
carla (oncall): joining. sam (support) — any customer reports?
sam (support): Acme Analytics and Quill Labs reported timeouts ~12:09 UTC. ~3 support tickets opened.
maria (eng): quick poke at routing: canary traffic appears to be routed to a mix of eu-west-1 and stale eu-west-2 edge backends due to an older geo-dns entry not evicting from the edge pool; KV cache mismatch on route table applied during split.
devin (sre): propose immediate mitigation: flip canary feature flag to stop new canary traffic (kill-switch) while we assess. Recommend also pause rollout and start rollback if flag flip doesn't stabilize.
maria (eng): ready to flip. Flag: eu_canary_v2 -> false. Doing via console now.
deploy-bot: Feature flag update: eu_canary_v2 set to false by maria (eng) at 12:12 UTC. (change-id: FF-362987-A)
carla (oncall): metrics: error rate dropping 6% -> 1.8% over 3 minutes. Good sign. Initiating controlled rollback to v2.1.6 for canary group.
maria (eng): rollback steps:
```
redwoodctl rollout cancel --id canary-3629876543
redwoodctl deploy --model v2.1.6 --region eu-west-1 --target canary
```
devin (sre): also invalidate edge prefix cache and evict stale DNS entries from edge pools:
```
edgectl invalidate --region eu-west-1 --prefix "/v1/"
dnsctl evict --zone eu-west-1 --record edge-backend-legacy
```
sam (support): sent templated customer communication to impacted accounts: "We detected a degraded canary rollout causing timeouts. We've rolled back the canary and are monitoring; services are stabilizing. ETA 15-30m. Contact support for any escalation"
carla (oncall): starting 1:1 handoff to nolan for next window (12:30-13:30 UTC). nolan, please ack and watch for error >2% for 15m.
nolan (oncall-2): acked. I'll monitor dashboards and trace tails, will escalate if thresholds breach.
incident-bot: INC-20260317-3629876543 created. severity:P1. owners: carla (oncall), maria (eng), devin (sre).
maria (eng): quick root-cause notes: likely inconsistent DNS propagation to edge pools during region split combined with a canary routing change that didn't clear the route cache. Action items: add preflight DNS/edge consistency check before canary, extend canary verification window to 10m, add auto-killflag on >3% error for 2m, and automate weight rollback for blue/green flips.
carla (oncall): monitoring shows stable error rate ~0.9% after rollback and cache invalidation. Closing active mitigation. Will file full postmortem and run follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
